versions.changelog:
- Initial release of score-analyzer skill for professional student score analysis from Excel files.
- Handles manual and automated data extraction, cleaning, and strict format validation.
- Performs advanced statistical analysis using dynamic percentile-based thresholds for passing/excellent rates.
- Generates comprehensive, narrative Markdown/Word/HTML reports with mandatory chart placeholders and embedded visualizations.
- Includes multi-stage output verification to ensure data quality, report completeness, and accurate metric calculation.
- Supports generation of individual student reports and ZIP packaging for final delivery.
